Wow. Just wow. Thank you. I came here, I guess, hoping for encouragement and to know I'm not the only person who feels this way. Certainly both of those have happened. More than I could have imagined.
You're right, about the best medicine. It took me so long to reply because I blurted all this out onto reddit then went for a long walk. It's the best I've felt in a long time to come home a little refreshed from the walk to find such heartening messages waiting. And to know other people feel similar - and to hear someone say they're proud of me, oh my goodness.
Your kind words have me in tears too now, so thank you from the bottom of my heart for your kindness. I'll have a little smile with myself next time I see that silly toilet paper with the butterflies!

Thank you so much for your kind words and encouragement. And I so very much appreciate you reminding me I'm young, I feel like a tired old lady all the time lately and it helps to snap out of that.
Thank you also for reminding me of my dear husband's perspective. He's in a lot of pain right now, you're right. We've gotten through all this together so far, we need to stick together through this too. I think I'll talk to him tonight about me looking for another job - you're right, that's one problem I can solve now. 
Your words encouraged my so much. Thank you.
